intro: Some of this is quiet practice. Some of it is standing in front of people.

items.title: On Stage at Ponnonam 2026/Playing at Humsam
items.description: On 22/08/2026, I performed violin at Ponnonam 2026, a community cultural event — playing alongside another musician on percussion, in front of a live audience.

images.alt: Rithu playing violin on stage next to another musician playing hand percussion, in front of a "Ponnonam 2026" banner

items.title: Playing at Church
items.description: Since 2022, I've been playing violin with my church's music ministry — a regular, ongoing way to use music for something bigger than just practising at home.

items.title: Dancing at Various Events
items.description: I have performed across various events outside and inside of school, like Harmony Day in Year 5 and Year 6, Humsam, and a community gathering.
